changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.comment:
A supervisor marking attendance for their team now has to be on site themselves: the position on the request is theirs, it is measured against the project's geofence, and an entry from outside the fence is refused (#839). What gets stored is the answer to "who marked this, from where, and how far from the site", next to recorded_by_id which already said who.
recorded_by_name is denormalized the way project_name is, so the attendance record reads without a join. recorded_by_latitude and recorded_by_longitude are the supervisor's position, kept apart from latitude and longitude, which describe the punch, so a reader never has to work out whose position a pair is: on a self-marked punch they are null, on a supervisor-marked one they are the recorder's. recorded_by_distance_meters is the measured distance at the time, kept because the project's coordinates and the radius can both change afterwards.
The existing rows are left null. Nothing was measured for them.
